parameters.query:
SELECT
  e.id AS equipment_id,
  e.serial_number,
  e.model_number,
  e.equipment_type,
  e.replacement_due_date,
  (e.replacement_due_date - CURRENT_DATE) AS days_until_due,
  CASE
    WHEN (e.replacement_due_date - CURRENT_DATE) <= 7  THEN 'critical'
    WHEN (e.replacement_due_date - CURRENT_DATE) <= 30 THEN 'urgent'
    WHEN (e.replacement_due_date - CURRENT_DATE) <= 180 THEN 'warning'
  END AS urgency_tier,
  f.id AS facility_id,
  f.name AS facility_name,
  fa.email AS admin_email,
  fa.full_name AS admin_name,
  fa.phone AS admin_phone
FROM zipsafe.equipment e
JOIN zipsafe.facilities f ON f.id = e.facility_id
JOIN zipsafe.facility_admins fa ON fa.facility_id = f.id AND fa.is_primary = TRUE
WHERE e.replacement_due_date IS NOT NULL
  AND e.status = 'active'
  AND (e.replacement_due_date - CURRENT_DATE) IN (7, 30, 180)
ORDER BY e.replacement_due_date ASC

parameters.subject: =[ZipSafe] {{ $json.subject_prefix }} Equipment Lifecycle: {{ $json.equipment_type }} {{ $json.serial_number }} — {{ $json.days_until_due }} days remaining
